{{Quote|Don't ever be afraid of what you feel, Vestara. Just know that you can use it. You ''must'' use it, or else it will use you.|Olaris Rhea, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="Omen" />}}
'''Olaris Rhea''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[41 ABY]], Rhea was appointed to be the [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Tyro|Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] after Khai had encountered a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] named [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]]. Rhea and her new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] served in the Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] aboard the captured [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Eternal Crusader]]''. After the members of the Tribe sensed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] [[43 ABY|two years later]], Rhea and [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] handpicked a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] to bring down Skywalker and recover Ship, who had abruptly left Kesh. Using Khai's unique connection to Ship, the strike team, led by Rhea, tracked the Meditation Sphere to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where they encountered [[Abeloth]], a female being who was able to control the world's deadly [[Plant/Legends|flora]]. She agreed to help keep the Sith safe while they searched for Ship. Meanwhile, the strike team's [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]], [[Yuvar Xal]], was plotting to overthrow Rhea and take command of the team for himself. Before he could execute his coup, the Meditation Sphere finally returned to the Sith.

Abeloth discovered Skywalker's location&mdash;along with his son, [[Ben Skywalker]]&mdash;to be [[Sinkhole Station]], a small [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw, and Ship transported the surviving Sith there. Rhea led the strike team's [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambush]] of the Skywalkers, and Xal initiated his coup during the battle. Due to Rhea's foresight, however, his betrayal failed, and he was killed by Khai, who was then captured by the Skywalkers. Khai escaped later during the battle; and as Ben prepared the Skywalkers' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', for flight, Rhea met up with Khai and the two remaining Sith. The other two were quickly dispatched by Luke, leaving only Rhea and her apprentice to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] him. The three fought on the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] that led to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. As the lift's door opened, Rhea and Khai saw Ben in the ''Jade Shadow'' opening [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on Ship. Luke took advantage of their distraction and quickly killed Rhea, while Khai fled.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Everything we have known for over five thousand years changed yesterday beyond imagining. For the first time since the ''Omen'' crashed in the Takara Mountains, we have found a way off Kesh. A way to fulfill our destiny. This&hellip;''Ship''&hellip;has sought us out for that selfsame purpose.|Olaris Rhea|<ref name="Omen" />}}
Olaris Rhea was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born on the remote<ref name="Omen" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She was [[Sith training|trained]] in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]<ref name="Omen" />&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] whose [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', crash-landed on Kesh in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] while attempting to deliver a shipment of [[Lignan crystal]]s to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> Rhea completed her training and became a respected member of the Tribe. By [[41 ABY]], she had achieved the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] on the [[Circle of Lords]], the Tribe's ruling council. As a Lady, she served on the council in the [[Circle Chambers]] in the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] of the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Tahv]].<ref name="Omen" />

In 41 ABY, [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], arrived on Kesh after refusing to join the [[One Sith]], a faction of Sith who followed the [[Rule of One]]. After landing in the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Temple]] [[Temple courtyard|courtyard]] in the [[Takara Mountains]], it spoke through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with a [[Sith Tyro]] named [[Vestara Khai]]. The Circle of Lords decided that since Ship's expressed purpose was to train [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]], the Sphere's interest in Khai warranted her promotion to the rank of apprentice, and Rhea was chosen to be her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]]. Ship then revealed to the Tribe that the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] had been all but destroyed, and now only a few [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] remained in hiding.<ref name="Omen" /> Soon after, Ship informed the Tribe of a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[S18 light freighter]] that was traveling from the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Ship called for five Sith to be part of a strike team to attack the vessel, and Rhea and Khai were chosen, along with fellow Sith [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Ruku Myal]], and [[Ivaar Workan]]. They were carried by Ship to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], and the Meditation Sphere [[Skirmish near Eriadu|attacked]] it, forcing it to land. The Sith landed in order to pursue and kill the six surviving crew members, and they decided to break into two groups&mdash;Rhea and Taalon in one, and Khai, Myal, and Workan in the other. Rhea and Taalon soon cornered four of the crew members, while the other Sith killed the other two. When the Sith finished their hunt, Taalon called them back to the freighter to take inventory.<ref name="First">{{InsiderCite|125|First Blood (short story)}}</ref>

Following the mission,<ref name="First" /> the Tribe began to use Ship to attack and capture more [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] in an effort to form a [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|new armada]] with the purpose of conquering [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for the Sith Empire. Rhea and her apprentice served aboard one of the first starships to be captured, the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'', and over the next two years, the armada expanded to include over two dozen ships.<ref name="Omen" />

===Recovering Ship===
{{Quote|I think Ship is allowing only Vestara to find it because she is young. Someone older might have a stronger will&mdash;a will powerful enough to compel its return.|Rhea, to her strike team|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|right|Vestara Khai, Rhea's apprentice]]
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] touched the [[Codex]], an ancient [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Relics|relic]], causing his presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to be magnified. As a result, his name was whispered through the Force to the members of the Tribe. Ship revealed to the Sith that Skywalker was the Grand Master of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and posed a threat to their planned conquest of the galaxy. An emergency meeting was held in the Circle Chambers in Tahv, and Rhea and the Tribe's leader, [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]], handpicked a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] to be led by Rhea, with the objective of hunting down Skywalker. However, during the meeting Ship abruptly left Kesh, following a call through the Force. The strike team was then assigned to find Ship, with the task of eliminating Skywalker coming second.<ref name="Omen" />

Rhea served as commander of the strike team aboard the ''Eternal Crusader'', with [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]] serving as the [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]]. They took advantage of Khai's special connection with Ship, using it to track the Meditation Sphere. Discontent arose within the ranks of the strike team, however, as Xal became displeased with Rhea's leadership, voicing his dissatisfaction that they were forced to rely on the word of her apprentice. However, the team finally tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. There, Rhea organized a search party to be sent down to the surface to recover Ship while the ''Eternal Crusader'' remained in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. The search party consisted of herself, Khai, Xal, his apprentice [[Ahri Raas]], and several other Sith, leaving the ship under the command of [[Sith Saber]] [[Baad Walusari]], whom Rhea trusted more than Xal.<ref name="Abyss" />

Before long, however, several of the Sith were killed by the planet's many deadly [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. Rhea decreed that if any of the team's members were killed they were to die quietly, and if they did so, their families back on Kesh would be commended, but if they died dishonorably, their families would be punished. Rhea and Khai hung back in the search, sending Xal, Raas, and the others ahead. Eventually, they met a being who called herself [[Abeloth]] who was able to control the world's deadly plant life, and agreed to protect the Sith during their search for Ship. Also&mdash;claiming to have been marooned on the world for thirty years&mdash;Abeloth agreed to return with the Sith to Kesh. In reality, however, Abeloth was the voice who had called out to Ship, and was still forcing Ship to ignore Khai's calls for him to return. The strike team's search continued fruitlessly, and as the ''Eternal Crusader''{{'s}} supplies were exhausted, Rhea finally decided to leave. Abeloth, however, argued for them to stay, but Rhea believed that returning to Kesh with Abeloth would more than make up for failing to recover Ship. Just then, however, Khai caught a glimpse of Ship, and Walusari [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Rhea to say that he had found Ship and was tracking it from the ''Eternal Crusader''. The search party chased after the Meditation Sphere, and as they crossed a river, Rhea was dragged into a whirlpool by a [[siphon reed]]. Despite Abeloth's warning, Khai attempted to save her Master. Khai caught up with her deep beneath the [[Water/Legends|waters]] and used her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut open the reed holding Rhea. Rhea then used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] them back up to the surface, where they were drawn from the water by Raas.<ref name="Abyss" />

As the hunt continued in vain, more and more Sith arrived in [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from the ''Eternal Crusader'' to join the search party, until at last the warship no longer had any crew left aboard. Ship remained hidden, and as support for Rhea declined, Xal prepared to initiate a coup to take over the strike team. Nonetheless, Abeloth, who had discovered that Skywalker, along with his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], was [[beyond shadows]]&mdash;the state of mind Force-sensitives achieved when they separated their mind from their bodies&mdash;at [[Sinkhole Station]], a small [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw, finally allowed Ship to return to the Sith. She insisted, however, that the Sith capture the Skywalkers and return with them to Kesh rather than kill them, suggesting that Xal would attain the rank of Lord, and that Rhea would become the [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] of the Sith.<ref name="Abyss" />

===Battle with the Skywalkers===
{{Quote|If Ship can take all of us in one trip, the Skywalkers must be very near. And they had to come in ''something''. Once Ship takes us to them&mdash;''"<br />"''Absolutely. We kill the Skywalkers and&hellip;''"<br />"''&hellip;we steal their vessel. How hard can it be?|Khai and Rhea, discussing their upcoming mission|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Luke Skywalker, exiled Grand Master of the Jedi Order and the strike team's target]]
The strike team arrived at Sinkhole Station and prepared to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambush]] the Skywalkers, and Rhea decided to change their objective back from capture to kill. The Sith broke into the station's control room, where they confronted the Skywalkers. After a short fight, the Jedi ran for the station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in an attempt to get to their starship, the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', covering their escape from the control room with [[azetal]] gas and [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]], leaving three of the attackers dead. Meanwhile, Xal, Raas, Walusari, and Khai were set up at a junction in the station. Rhea warned them that the Skywalkers were headed their way, and as Khai and Walusari threw their grenades at the Jedi, Xal and Raas pushed the grenades back at them before throwing their own [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]] at the Skywalkers. Rhea had foreseen this betrayal, however, and had given Khai and Walusari fake grenades to throw first. Khai then killed Xal, but Raas and Walusari were subsequently eliminated by the Skywalkers, and Luke quickly captured Khai. As the Skywalkers were ambushed a third time, Khai escaped, but the Jedi defeated the other Sith and made it safely to the hangar. Rhea met up with Khai and the other two surviving Sith while Ben prepared the ''Jade Shadow'' for flight and Luke returned inside the Station on a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].<ref name="Abyss" />

Rhea, Khai, and the two remaining Sith waited at the turbolift entrance for Skywalker, who quickly dispatched the two others. Rhea and Khai, however, jumped into the turbolift and began to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] him. They scored several glancing hits on Skywalker, damaging his [[Environment suit/Legends|vac suit]]. The Sith pressed their advantage, but the Grand Master deflected one of Khai's blaster shots back at her foot, and he proceeded to duel with Rhea, using the Force to keep Khai from maneuvering to attack him. Behind Luke, the exit panel on the lift finally opened to the hangar, and Ben&mdash;in the ''Jade Shadow''&mdash;opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on Ship. The Sith were distracted by the sudden light, and the visors on their vac suits darkened, temporarily hindering their vision. Rhea and Khai dove evasively, but Luke followed Rhea and quickly [[Cho mok/Legends|cut off]] her leg and [[Cho sun/Legends|arm]], before swiftly [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating]] her. Khai, realizing she was severely outmatched, fled.<ref name="Abyss" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Much admiration will be accorded me for killing Luke Skywalker. Especially by the family of Lady Rhea, whom you slew.|Viun Gaalan|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
The Skywalkers tracked Khai to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where Khai called in members of her Tribe to retrieve her. A shuttle convoy led by Lord [[Viun Gaalan]] arrived and was confronted by the Skywalkers. Gaalan told Luke that Rhea's family would grant him much admiration for killing the Grand Master; however, in the [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|ensuing duel]], Gaalan was defeated and forced to flee, while Khai was captured.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash" /> The Jedi were soon accosted by a Sith fleet under the command of High Lord [[Sarasu Taalon]], who convinced them to form an alliance for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to defeat Abeloth. Khai's father, the [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]], was allowed to board the ''Jade Shadow'' to speak privately with his daughter; and he confided in her that he, too, grieved over Rhea's death. Vestara responded that Rhea had died well, adding that there was no dishonor in being killed by the Skywalkers.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You may as well stand, Vestara. We both know I'm not going to kill a talented apprentice over a few inviolable rules.|Rhea, to Khai|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Olaris Rhea was tall, with pale blonde hair and blue eyes. She was authoritative and, as one of the most powerful Sith in the Tribe, held great power in the Circle of Lords. Tall, slender, and graceful, she was also somewhat arrogant, and the lower-ranking members of the Tribe found her to be rather imposing.<ref name="Omen" /> Rhea was known to be a strict teacher; however, she had a soft spot for her apprentice. On the planet to which they tracked Ship in the Maw, Khai grew frustrated with Rhea for failing to see how critical their situation was, and Rhea noted that such disrespect was something that apprentices never lived to do twice. She listened to Khai, however, and, realizing her apprentice was correct, spared her life. Rhea was also exceedingly clever, foreseeing that Xal would attempt to carry out his coup during the battle with the Skywalkers, and giving both Khai and Walusari fake grenades to throw so that they would not be killed when Xal and his apprentice threw them back.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|The strike force will prepare to launch after Ship as soon as you are prepared under the command of Lady Rhea.|Darish Vol, on Rhea|<ref name="Omen" />}}
Rhea was a Force-sensitive, and trained in the ways of the dark side of the Force. As a member of the Circle of Lords, Rhea was one of the most powerful and respected Sith on Kesh. She was acknowledged as a strong leader, as she was put in command of the Tribe's strike team.<ref name="Omen" /> Rhea was proficient in telekinesis techniques, and was also a skilled lightsaber duelist, as she was able to hold her own, for a short time, against the Jedi Grand Master, Luke Skywalker. Khai even managed to injure him, though it was revealed he allowed this in order to establish a [[Blood trail|Blood Trail]].<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Olaris Rhea was created by author [[Christie Golden]] for her first ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second of nine novels in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. Rhea wasn't designated a first name until the third novel of the series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', in which she was given the name "Olaris." Although her eyes were identified as blue in ''Omen'', they were noted as green in ''Abyss''. Rhea later appeared in "[[First Blood (short story)|First Blood]]," a short story written by Golden.
